class.name: CgameLagCompensation
class.brief_description: Server-side rewind of target positions for fair PvP hit detection.

method.name: record
method.description: Appends a sample and drops samples older than the history window (always keeping two).

method.name: forget
method.description: Drops the history of one character.

method.name: prune
method.description: Drops the history of every character whose id is not a key of [param alive_ids].

method.name: sample_count
method.description: Returns the number of stored samples for a character.

method.name: rewind_for
method.description: Returns how far back to judge an attacker with this round-trip time: [code]round_trip * 0.5 + client interpolation[/code], clamped to the maximum rewind. Zero, negative or non-finite input returns [code]0.0[/code].

method.name: position_at
method.description: Returns the interpolated position at time [param at]. Returns [param fallback] when there is no history or [param at] is not older than the newest sample, and the oldest sample when [param at] precedes the history.

method.name: get_history_seconds
method.description: Returns the length of the history window, [code]0.5[/code] seconds.

method.name: get_client_interpolation
method.description: Returns the assumed client interpolation delay, [code]0.12[/code] seconds.
